question: Who can I contact about making a complaint under Manitoba’s Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act?
generated_answer:

Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner

275 Portage Avenue

Winnipeg, MB R3C 1C4

Phone: 204-945-8888

http://www.ocim.gov.mb.ca/english/foip.html
